body: The Cocos (Keeling) Islands consist of two coral atolls and are an Australian territory, counted as part of Australia in country streaks.
The landscape is made up of bright white sand, many palms, and mowed grass, with significantly less forest and hills compared to Christmas Island.
A unique car with a snorkel at the front right and visible bed edges is found on West Island.
A white car with rear edges visible is found in Bantam, but may be fully blurred; other clues are important before guessing.
Bantam Village is recognizable by its cross-hatched brick pavement.
The Cocos Islands runway is the widest paved road on the island, with mowed grass on both sides and a follow car.
Many trekkers walk the coastline on white sand, with the ocean on one side and palms on the other.
Direction Island is identifiable by beaches with significantly more litter such as bricks, styrofoam, and dead coral, and trekkers walking among many palms.
The inland trekker on Pulau Luar (Horsburgh Island) is seen amid dry yellow grass and sparser vegetation.
A medium-sized boat with a large seating capacity is seen from West Island to Bantam.
A small boat with black bars at the rear is observed in the northern area.
A small dark grey boat with a woman sitting at the back is found in the southern area.
